name: ZOMBANWA!!

boost.name: OHAYOLLIE
effect: Draw 1 card. Add this card to your Gauge.
BEFORE: Scream. Your opponent discards 1 random card.
HIT: Gain Advantage.
description: Ollie的招牌招呼語「ZOMBANWA!!」（Zombie + Konbanwa），以突如其來的尖叫聲嚇阻對手，搶奪節奏。代表她吵鬧、精力充沛的個性。

name: Shat Up!

boost.name: Otsucrazy!
effect: +2 Power. AFTER: Retreat 1.
Ignore Guard.
HIT: Your opponent cannot use Boost effects until the end of their next turn.
description: Ollie經典發音錯誤「Shat up!」（Shut up的變體），成為粉絲間廣為流傳的迷因。此卡代表她以混亂打斷對手節奏的能力。

name: Doko? Koko

boost.name: Zombie Moan
effect: Move up to 3 spaces. Draw 1 card.
BEFORE: Advance or Retreat up to 3 spaces. This attack hits if you switched sides with the opponent.
description: 來自Minecraft聯動經典片段「Doko?（在哪裡？）／Koko（這裡）」，展現Ollie混沌難捉摸的移動方式，讓對手摸不清她的位置。

name: Eka Prasetya Pancakarsa

boost.name: Path of Sincerity
effect: +3 Power. Ignore Armor.
Ignore Armor.
CRITICAL: +2 Power.
HIT: Push 2.
description: 以Ollie頭上貫穿的黑銀劍「Eka Prasetya Pancakarsa（真誠之路／一個承諾，五個決心）」命名。近距離強力一擊，儘管劍穿頭部對殭屍來說毫髮無傷。

name: Udin Toss

boost.name: Udin Fetch
effect: Return this card to your hand. Discard 1 card.
HIT: Pull the opponent 1 space.
AFTER: Gain 1 life.
description: Ollie擲出掛在劍上的縫合小熊Udin進行遠距攻擊。Udin是Ollie的標誌性隨行角色，這張卡代表她與粉絲（Zomrade）之間的情感連結與治癒效果。

name: Annyeonghasseyo Ollie imnida

boost.name: Language Switch
effect: Your opponent discards 1 card at random. Draw 1 card.
BEFORE: Name a Range value (1-6). This attack's Range becomes that value.
HIT: +2 Power for each language switch effect used this game.
description: Ollie雖是印尼VTuber卻經常以韓語自我介紹，體現她多語混雜的風格。此卡代表她讓人眼花撩亂的語種切換，讓對手難以預測下一步。

name: Mismatched Shoes

boost.name: Couldn't Decide
effect: +3 Speed. HIT: Draw 1.
BEFORE: Choose two: Advance 1, Retreat 1, or +1 Power.
Stun Immunity.
description: Ollie官方設定中穿著不對稱的鞋子（左腳紅色厚底鞋、右腳黑色踝靴），原因是「無法決定穿哪雙所以都穿」。此卡展現她出奇不意的步伐與難以預測的攻勢。

name: Zombie Revival

boost.name: Restore Hope
effect: Gain 3 life. Draw up to 2 cards.
BEFORE: Gain 2 life for each card in your Gauge.
HIT: Return 1 card from your Discard to your hand.
description: Ollie擁有重生之力，主要用於「恢復希望與夢想」。此卡代表她身為殭屍的復活能力——即使陷入劣勢也能重新站起來繼續奮戰。

name: JOLLIE JOLLIE

boost.name: Dance Break
effect: Draw 2 cards. You may add 1 card from your hand to your Gauge.
BEFORE: +1 Power for each card in your hand.
HIT: Gain Advantage. Draw 1 card.
AFTER: Move up to 2 spaces.
description: Ollie的首張原創單曲（2022年4月發行），充滿活力與歡樂的偶像歌曲。作為Ultra卡，代表她站上舞台展現偶像魅力的高光時刻——以歌聲和舞蹈席捲全場。

name: HISTORY

boost.name: Zombie Idol
effect: +3 Power. Stun Immunity. NOW: Close 1.
BEFORE: Your opponent discards cards equal to the number of Zomrade cards in your Discard.
HIT: Draw 3 cards. Gain 3 life.
This attack cannot be stopped by Guard or Armor.
description: Ollie的第三張原創單曲（2024年10月發行），回顧她從出道以來的成長歷程。作為最強Ultra卡，代表她作為頂級殭屍偶像的巔峰實力——回顧過去、立足當下、開創未來。
